The '''Korsinata''' was a stadium located in [[Tahv]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. It housed a pentagonal playing field where [[rake-riding]]&mdash;a dangerous sport wherein [[Human/Legends|Humans]] wrangled with [[uvak]]s whose wings had been clipped&mdash;was held.
